description: The customer calculator: configuration · tier · band. Inputs as the SPA has them (the configuration and its width or run in millimetres, the layout, the tier with its materials and hardware in one line); the finishes are the configurator's picks — one selection on the site, never a second materials UI; the preview a drawn elevation at real proportions with the chosen board applied under a shading layer; the band a from–to guide from the versioned band table (data/band-table.json, computed server-side at /api/band), shown with its derivation and its watermark, never a single figure; 'take this further' hands the band to the enquiry; 'see it in a room' hands the materials to the one render path, labelled a visualisation. States: idle, active (priced), locked (sent).
consumers: sturij-studio (when the Studio lands on the core)
